model.title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 1019 Avenue H in Fort Madison, Iowa, as the Martin L. Graber Post Office.
model.meta: Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee, Oversight and Government Reform Committee · Rep. Mariannette Miller-Meeks (R-IA)

summary.text: The bill would rename the postal facility located at 1019 Avenue H in Fort Madison, Iowa, in honor of Martin L. Graber.
